D.treatment: students who had visited a physics laboratory
D.comparison: students who had not visited a physics laboratory

O.outcome_detail: opportunity to visit or know a physics laboratory

cells.quote: "Os dados coletados mostraram que mais da metade dos alunos, 53%, não tiveram a oportunidade de visitar ou conhecer um laboratório de física."
cells.note: No study text is available; quote copied from the wiki entry. The entry states that 53% had not visited or known a physics laboratory and that the remaining 47% had visited one at IFPI/Campus Picos events, not at their own schools.
